en.title: Create a Short-Video Script
en.description: Develop a 60-second video script using AI for a fictional creator channel.
en.outcome: You can write AI instructions that produce engaging, structured short-video scripts.
en.explanation: Short-form video needs tight structure: hook → value → call-to-action. AI can help draft scripts, but you need to specify the format, tone, and duration.

worked_example.scenario: TechTidy channel: 'How to organize your digital workspace'
worked_example.bad_attempt: Write a video script about organizing.
worked_example.good_attempt:
Goal: Write a 60-second video script about organizing a digital workspace.
Context: TechTidy channel, audience is young professionals. Style: fast-paced, practical.
Constraints: Hook in first 5 seconds. 3 actionable tips. End with CTA. Under 150 words.
Output: Script with timestamp markers and visual cues.
worked_example.why_better: Specifies duration, style, structure, and production details.

interactive_task.instruction: Write an AI instruction to create a 60-second video script for the TechTidy channel. Topic: '5 ways to declutter your phone in 2 minutes.' Target audience: Gen Z and young professionals.
hints: Think about the hook — what grabs attention in the first 3 seconds?
How many tips fit in 60 seconds?
What visual cues would help the editor?
interactive_task.sample_good_response:
Goal: Create a 60-second video script about decluttering your phone quickly.
Context: TechTidy channel, Gen Z/young professional audience. Energetic, practical tone.
Constraints: Hook in first 3 seconds (start with a surprising fact). 5 quick tips, ~10 sec each. End with subscribe CTA. Under 160 words. No jargon.
Output: Script with [TIMESTAMP], [VISUAL], [TEXT ON SCREEN] markers. Include suggested background music mood.

understanding_checks.question: What's the most important part of a short-form video script?
options: A strong hook in the first few seconds
Using as many words as possible
Making it at least 5 minutes long
Including complex vocabulary
understanding_checks.explanation: On platforms like Instagram and YouTube Shorts, viewers decide in 1-3 seconds whether to keep watching.

understanding_checks.question: Why should you specify production details in your AI instruction?
options: They help the AI generate more useful, production-ready output
They make the instruction longer
AI can't write scripts without them
They replace the need for editing
understanding_checks.explanation: Timestamp markers, visual cues, and text overlays make the script immediately useful for production.

feedback_templates.pass: Excellent! Your instruction would produce a production-ready script.
feedback_templates.partial: Good start! Add more structure details like timestamps and visual cues.
feedback_templates.fail: Try again. Think about: hook, structure, timing, and production format.

en.retry_hint: Review the worked example and try again.
en.recap: You practiced creating scripts with AI. Key: specify hook, timing, audience, and production format for usable output.

glossary_terms.definition: The attention-grabbing opening seconds of a video that makes viewers want to keep watching.
A prompt telling viewers what to do next (subscribe, like, comment).
